answer: Only keys with a current 30-minute, globally simultaneous in-person attendance certificate may earn; each extra alias needs another person for 30 minutes. At willow, saffron and ocean halls, stewards assign one seat and key per person, watch the full session and sign seat receipts; the registry expires old rounds and rejects duplicate seats. Ten aliases cost 10 people and 300 person-minutes per round. Rotating stewards and surprise room inspections deter invented attendance; colluding venues remain a risk.
